sentences.text: Aba/1112/2024 on 12 November, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  ABA No.1112 of 2024  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Ravindra S. Rawat, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. S.C. Dumka, A.G.A. for the State.
Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No.301 of 2024, under Sections 420, 468 IPC, Police Station Rishikesh, District Dehradun.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
According to the FIR, the informant booked a trip through a travel agency.
The applicant spoke on behalf of the travel agency and assured of the arrangement, but when the informant reached Rishikesh, he found that the registration was forged.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is falsely implicated; parties have settled the dispute; the applicant did not commit any offence.
State to file objections.

Having considered the submissions, as an ad interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to her furnishing personal bonds with two sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO").

In addition to it, the applicant shall also comply with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall co-operate with the investigation.
(ii) She shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
(iii) She shall not leave the country without prior permission of the court concerned.

(iv) She shall deposit her passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, the applicant do not have passport, she shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.

(Ravindra Maithani J.) 12.11.2024 RV ABA/1112/2024 on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40081179/
